title: 定前五盖暂伏
note: 五盖暂伏；心已能持续安住所缘

evidence.pali: 225 . ‘‘Tassime pañca nīvaraṇe pahīne attani samanupassato pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
evidence.chinese_simplified: 225. “当他看到自身已断除这五盖时，欣喜生起；欣喜者生起喜；心喜者身轻安；身轻安者感受乐；有乐者心入定。”
evidence.english: 225. For him who sees these five hindrances as abandoned in himself, joy arises. For one who is joyful, rapture arises. For one whose mind is rapturous, the body becomes tranquil. One with a tranquil body experiences happiness. The mind of one who is happy becomes concentrated.

isolation_reason: 旧图保留的独立概念有直接 V4 逐句证据，但当前闭包没有足够直接的关系句将其连接到另一发布节点；为避免凭概念相似度补边，保留为可检索、可引用的独立节点。
